name: command-code
description: Command Code Provider API with multiple API keys for load distribution. Each account gets 2 groups (OpenAI + Anthropic format). Useful when you have several accounts with limited per-key quota.
keyInstructions: Subscribe to multiple Command Code Provider plans. For each account: create an API key from Studio at https://commandcode.ai/studio and provide it when prompted. Keys are stored separately in VS Code's keystore.
